assets.caption: Figure 6.3  Flow rate 300 m³/h to 10 000 m³/h
assets.notes: Log-log pressure drop chart for carbon steel water pipes at 20°C, flow rate range 300–10 000 m³/h. Left y-axis: pressure drop (Pa/m length), right y-axis: pressure drop (bar/100 m), x-axis: flow rate (m³/h). Diagonal lines represent pipe nominal diameters. Caption is the figure title line immediately above the chart body.
